title: Turkish — ICAO Doc 9303 ASCII (passport MRZ)
authority: ICAO Doc 9303 Part 3 (8th ed., 2021), §6.A transliteration of multinational Latin characters
description: Turkish Latin names reduced to the ICAO MRZ alphabet: Ç→C, Ğ→G, I/ı and İ/i→I, Ö→O, Ş→S, Ü→U, circumflexed â î û→a i u. This is how Turkish names appear in the machine-readable zone and in most ASCII-only systems.
notes: ICAO §6.A also permits Ö→OE and Ü→UE (or UXX); the single-letter forms are used here, consistent with weak secondary sources on Turkish passports. German-issued documents for Turkish-origin holders may show GOEKHAN, SUEKRUE.
No Turkish government text (Nüfus ve Vatandaşlık İşleri) stating the MRZ mapping was found; evidence for O/U rather than OE/UE is secondary.

Casing: the engine lower-cases İ to i (Python gives i + U+0307) and I to i; both fold to I, so the dotted/dotless distinction does not matter for ASCII output. A stray combining dot above (U+0307) is dropped.
English-phonetic renderings (Ç→CH, Ş→SH, C→J, Ğ dropped: Doğan → Doan) are not passport forms and are not produced here.
Letters q, w, x are not native Turkish letters but are passed through for foreign names.
